notes.title: RAGER Demo Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950646/5a24c71ee2379973848a9819f8173c37476ce1a8.png

RAGER Demo Updated – Now Live!
Early Access Coming Fall 2025 | Join Us for Steam Next Fest June 9th!

We're thrilled to announce a major update to the RAGER demo – and there's never been a better time to jump in!

After successfully completing the Meta Ignition program, we've been hard at work pushing every aspect of RAGER to the next level as we gear up for Early Access this fall. With that in mind, we’ve just dropped a huge update to the demo so you can get a firsthand taste of what’s coming.

What’s New?
Almost everything. We’ve overhauled:

 ⚔️ Game design and combat flow
 🎨 Visuals and level design
 🎵 Music and sound design

This is more than just a polish pass — it's a full-on evolution.

What’s in the Demo?
You’ll get to play through 2 campaign levels:

 In the first, you'll be slicing enemies with swords
 In the second, you'll be smashing them with maces
 Each level offers a distinct feel, giving you a preview of the diverse combat experiences in the full game.

Steam Next Fest – We’re In!
We’ll be participating in Steam Next Fest starting June 9th, so be sure to stop by, try the demo, and add RAGER to your wishlist if you haven’t already!

Website: insaneprey.com
